metadata.title: Data Handling and Use

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing how data may be accessed, processed, shared, and used in accordance with classification, purpose, and institutional policy.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data access services, analytics platforms, processing environments, and data-sharing interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern enforcing permissible data access, processing, and sharing behavior once data exists.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Data handling rules apply to data with established ownership, authority, and baseline trust.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Data classification determines permissible handling, processing context, and sharing scope.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Data handling aligns with NIST SP 800-53 controls governing access enforcement, purpose limitation, and privacy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Data use is constrained by declared purpose and minimization principles.

metadata.remarks: Data Handling and Use defines enforceable constraints on how data may be accessed, processed, and shared after collection and classification. This pattern ensures data use remains aligned with declared purpose, sensitivity, and institutional policy, preventing misuse or scope creep.

components.title: Purpose-Bound Data Use
components.description: Ensures data is accessed and processed only for explicitly approved purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of data beyond its approved or disclosed purpose.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Purpose binding and governance controls prevent unauthorized reuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data processing is restricted to approved and documented purposes.

components.title: Context-Sensitive Access and Processing
components.description: Restricts data access and processing based on role, environment, and risk context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid access to process data in unauthorized or higher-risk contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access enforcement reflects data classification and usage context.
Least privilege is enforced for data processing.

components.title: Controlled Data Sharing
components.description: Ensures data is shared only with authorized parties and under approved conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships to share data outside approved boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-driven sharing controls restrict unauthorized dissemination.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow enforcement governs data sharing.

components.title: Data Use Observability
components.description: Provides auditability and traceability of data access, processing, and sharing activities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or deletion of evidence related to unauthorized data use.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logging and monitoring support accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data usage events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection of inappropriate use.
